{"notes": "Visit 3 (ended 5:15). Picture: one unbroken dark chain from START across the top, round the nose curve at left and along the bottom line to about (13.5, 15.4). Nothing pale or disconnected. The nose is now connected, so the bottom line is underway. A small cluster of dominoes near (11-12, 15) looks slightly crowded; worth checking at the next visit. I still can't tell who physically placed what.

Leo: Strongest visit. At 4:45 he found the break (a jammed domino just before the nose), told Tom, and asked him to hold off so they wouldn't bump. At 5:00 he said the nose was fixed and everything falls from the start; the picture matches that. He then re-planned the remaining time: Priya takes the far end of the bottom line, Maya continues from the nose, and he joins the middle when they are a hand apart. Clear, verified, acting on the tail-bend check I'd asked for. Leadership 4-5, collaboration and execution high.

Priya: Silent this visit; Leo directed her. No new evidence on her top-line role. Earlier leadership stands, with the 1:45 contradiction. See whether she does the far-end work.

Tom: Silent; was told to hold off. His joins-checking didn't catch the jam, so his contribution is still unclear. Check what he did.

Maya: Third visit with nothing heard from her. Leo calls the bottom line hers, but that's his claim and I haven't seen it. Bottom line progress isn't credit to anyone yet. Ask her directly.

Next: confirm who is building the bottom line, whether the two ends join, and the final fall."}
